name: secondread
blurb: Six checks over a real syntax tree. It asks the questions a reviewer would, and says what it cannot answer itself.
description: Paste code, find out what a reviewer would ask

name: notepad
blurb: A language for the back of an envelope. Units, money and dates, each line worked out in the margin.
description: Type maths in prose, answers in the margin

name: pc-audit
blurb: Reads what Windows already measured about itself, and prints "not measured" where the rest of the genre guesses.
description: A read-only Windows audit that will not print a number it did not measure. Profiles for frame rate, startup and battery, plus an account of the tweaks it refuses to recommend.

name: discern
blurb: Wilson intervals and paired McNemar, so two eval runs are not called apart when the difference is noise.
description: Eval harness that knows when a difference is noise

name: depgraph
blurb: One recursive CTE walks the whole npm graph, so a package reachable forty ways is still counted once.
description: The true install cost of an npm dependency

name: decoder
blurb: Paste a token, a hash, a timestamp. It names it, opens it, and keeps opening what it finds inside.
description: Paste anything, find out what it is

name: tokenview
blurb: Watch a sentence break into the pieces a model reads, then watch its meaning land on a map.
description: Tokenizer and embedding map for language models

name: hikari
blurb: Desktop widgets that are a folder and two files. A capability has to be asked for, and is refused by default.
description: Desktop widgets in HTML, CSS and JavaScript

name: yozora
blurb: Fifteen palettes, a type scale and the texture rules, as one small system every page here runs on.
description: Fifteen nocturnal colour themes for VS Code and terminals

name: skill-radar
blurb: Which agent skill actually fires for a given sentence, and which two are quietly competing.
description: Which agent skill actually fires, and why

name: shelfwear
blurb: Reads the files Steam already wrote to tell you what you bought and never launched.
description: What your Steam library actually gets played

name: streaming-markdown
blurb: Trim a half-arrived markdown frame to the longest valid prefix, so nothing has to be un-rendered.
description: Render streamed markdown without the flicker

name: pane
blurb: Drive a Chrome tab from a script. Caching off, fonts waited for, clips clamped, frames matched.
description: Script a Chrome tab over the DevTools Protocol

name: neon-bar
blurb: A status bar for Windows, on fifteen palettes. Opaque, because a see-through bar is one a grey wallpaper can erase.
description: A themeable Zebar status bar for Windows

name: skill-lint
blurb: Broken references, colliding triggers and context bloat in an agent's SKILL.md.

name: agent-skills
blurb: The skills themselves, each one written because a specific failure kept happening.
description: Skills for coding agents, built from real failures
